_note: 學習路徑內容建置第6批 #5／6：與現在事實相反的假設 present unreal conditional（eng.t_adv.subj.present-unreal，學測級／高階）。If + 過去簡單式, 主句 would/could/might + 原形；be 動詞一律用 were（If I were you）；因為是想像，主句用 would 不用 will；比較真實條件（If + 現在式, will）vs 想像相反（If + 過去式, would）。高階特別防第二正解：每題用 if 子句時態或主句情態鎖唯一正解，並明確區分真實 vs 假設。經對抗式英語母語複核（每選項代入 stem 驗唯一正解、play-through 朗讀）。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix sjp_）。

units.title_zh: 與現在事實相反的假設（If + 過去式, would + 原形）
units.can_do: 我能用「If ＋ 過去簡單式, 主句 would／could／might ＋ 原形」表達與現在事實相反的想像；知道 be 動詞在這種假設一律用 were（If I were you），主句用 would 不用 will，並能分辨真實條件（If ＋ 現在式, will）和想像相反（If ＋ 過去式, would）。
units.situation_group: 假設語氣 The present unreal conditional
units.subject: eng

claims.text: For something that is not true now (imaginary / contrary to present fact), use 'If + past simple, ... would + base verb': If I had a million dollars, I would travel the world.
claims.verification_ref: 與現在事實相反＝If ＋ 過去簡單式, would ＋ 原形；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In the unreal conditional, use 'were' for all persons with 'be', including 'If I were you': If I were you, I would study harder.
claims.verification_ref: 假設語氣 be 動詞一律用 were（含 If I were you）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The main clause can use 'would', 'could', or 'might' + base verb: If she studied more, she could pass the exam.
claims.verification_ref: 主句可用 would/could/might ＋ 原形；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Because the situation is imaginary, the main clause uses 'would' (not 'will') and the verb after would/could/might is in the base form: If I knew the answer, I would tell you. (not 'I will tell you')
claims.verification_ref: 想像的主句用 would 不用 will、情態後接原形；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A real / likely condition uses 'If + present, ... will + base' (If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home); an unreal / imaginary one uses 'If + past, ... would + base' (If I lived on the moon, I would see the Earth every day).
claims.verification_ref: 真實條件 If+現在式,will vs 想像相反 If+過去式,would；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: To talk about a situation that is the opposite of the present and purely imaginary, use: If + past simple, and in the main clause would + base form. Here the past tense does not mean the past; it shows that this is not really true. For example, If I had more time (in fact I am busy).
teach.zh_hint: 要講「與現在事實相反、純想像」的情況，用：If ＋ 過去簡單式，主句 would ＋ 原形。過去式在這裡不是講過去，而是表示「這其實不是真的」。例如 If I had more time（其實我沒空）。

teach.body: If I had more free time, I would learn the piano.
teach.zh_hint: 如果我有多一點空閒時間，我就會去學鋼琴。其實我沒空——想像。

teach.body: In this kind of imaginary sentence, the verb be is always were (even with I, he, and she); the most common example is If I were you. In the main clause, besides would, you can also use could (would be able to) or might (might possibly).
teach.zh_hint: be 動詞在這種假設一律用 were（連 I／he／she 都用 were），最常見的是 If I were you（如果我是你）。主句除了 would，也可以用 could（就能）或 might（可能會）。

teach.body: If I were you, I would say sorry. If he studied harder, he could get better grades.
teach.zh_hint: 如果我是你，我會道歉。如果他更用功，就能拿更好的成績。were／could。

teach.body: Key point: because it is imaginary, the main clause uses would (not will), and would / could / might are followed by a base-form verb. Compare the two: real and possible (If + present, will) versus imaginary and opposite (If + past, would).
teach.zh_hint: 重點：因為是想像，主句用 would（不是 will），而且 would／could／might 後面接原形。比較兩種：真實又可能（If ＋ 現在式，will）vs 想像相反（If ＋ 過去式，would）。

teach.body: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.
teach.zh_hint: 如果明天下雨，我就待在家裡。這是「真實又可能」的條件（If ＋ 現在式, will），拿來對比前面「想像相反」的 If ＋ 過去式, would。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：If I had a lot of money, I ____ travel around the world.（如果我有很多錢，我就會環遊世界——其實我沒有，純想像）

distractor_rationales.will: if 子句用了過去式 had（表示與現在相反的想像），主句要用 would，不是 will。
distractor_rationales.would to: would 後面直接接原形 travel，沒有 to（×would to travel）。
distractor_rationales.am going to: am going to 講真實的未來打算；這是想像相反的情況，用 would。

practice.feedback: if 子句過去式 had（想像）→ 主句用 would ＋ 原形：I would travel around the world。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：If I ____ you, I would apologize to her right now.（如果我是你，我現在就會跟她道歉）

distractor_rationales.am: am 是現在事實（我是我）；假設「如果我是你」是與事實相反，be 動詞用 were：If I were you。
distractor_rationales.will be: will be 講未來；「如果我是你」是想像相反的假設，固定用 If I were you。
distractor_rationales.would be: would 用在主句，不放在 if 子句裡（×If I would be you）；if 子句用 were。

practice.feedback: 假設語氣 be 動詞一律用 were，固定說法 If I were you：If I were you, I would apologize。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：If it ____ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.（如果明天下雨，我們就取消野餐——真實又可能的情況）

distractor_rationales.rained: 主句是 will cancel（真實又可能），if 子句要用現在式 rains，不是過去式 rained。
distractor_rationales.will rain: if 子句（條件句）本身不用 will；真實條件的 if 子句用現在式 rains。
distractor_rationales.would rain: would 用在想像相反的主句；這題主句是 will cancel（真實），if 子句用現在式 rains。

practice.feedback: 真實又可能的條件：If ＋ 現在式（rains）, 主句 will：If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic。

practice.stem: 填入正確的詞：If she practiced every day, she ____ play the guitar beautifully.（如果她每天練習，就能把吉他彈得很好——其實她沒有每天練）

distractor_rationales.can: if 子句用過去式 practiced（想像相反），主句要用 could（或 would／might），不是 can。
distractor_rationales.could to: could 後面直接接原形 play，沒有 to（×could to play）。
distractor_rationales.will be able to: will 用在真實又可能的情況；這是想像相反，主句用 could。

practice.feedback: 想像相反的主句可用 could ＋ 原形：If she practiced every day, she could play the guitar beautifully。

practice.stem: 選出正確的「與現在事實相反」假設句（If ＋ 過去式, would ＋ 原形）：
practice.answer: If I knew his number, I would call him.
options: If I knew his number, I would call him.
If I know his number, I would call him.
If I knew his number, I will call him.
If I would know his number, I would call him.

主句用了 would（想像），if 子句就要用過去式 knew，不是現在式 know。
if 子句用過去式 knew（想像），主句要用 would，不是 will。
distractor_rationales.If I would know his number, I would call: would 不放在 if 子句裡（×If I would know）；if 子句用過去式 knew。

practice.feedback: 與現在相反：If ＋ 過去式（knew）, 主句 would ＋ 原形（call）：If I knew his number, I would call him。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: If I were a bird, I would fly over the mountains and visit faraway places.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：If I were（假設 be 用 were）和 I would fly（想像主句 would ＋ 原形）有沒有用對，faraway／places 有沒有漏，逗號和句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。if 子句句尾略微停頓再接主句；would／were 輕讀、原形動詞稍清楚，句尾下收。

lines.text: If I had more free time, I would read more books.
lines.intonation: if 子句後略停、would read 稍強調、句尾下收

lines.text: If I were you, I would take the earlier train.
lines.intonation: were 輕讀、would take 稍強調、句尾下收
